summary: Verified the Emergent-budget-exhausted UX fix end-to-end. Backend now maps 'Budget has been exceeded' to error_code='EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED' and returns a clean friendly message via GET /api/rom/translate/status/{job_id}. Worker short-circuits remaining batches once a fatal budget/invalid-key error hits (a 6-batch/2-job pytest run against the real budget-exhausted key finished in ~2.2s). Frontend shows a Sonner toast with the Czech message and an 'Otevřít nastavení' action button that opens the ai-settings-dialog; terminal-log shows friendly '! ERROR:' line with zero raw litellm technical noise.
passed: Unit: _error_code maps 'Budget has been exceeded' / 'EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED:' -> EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
Unit: _friendly_error(budget) mentions Profile/Manage plan/Universal Key/Settings; contains no litellm/openaiexception noise
Unit: _friendly_error for QUOTA_EXCEEDED / INVALID_KEY / TIMEOUT contains actionable next step
E2E: POST /api/rom/translate provider=emergent with 60 strings (3 batches) -> status=error with error_code='EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED', clean friendly text, elapsed well under 45s
E2E fail-fast: 80-string / 4-batch job also ends with EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED and dedup keeps errors[] <=2 unique entries; overall pytest module for 2 E2E jobs completed in 2.24s
Regression: status endpoint always returns error_code/error/errors keys even mid-run

UI: uploading small.gb + extract + translate against real budget-exhausted key => terminal shows 'ERROR: Emergent Universal Key credit is exhausted. Add balance in Profile → Manage plan → Universal Key, or open Settings and switch to your own AI provider (Gemini / OpenAI / Anthropic).'
UI: terminal-log contains NO 'litellm', 'OpenAIException' or 'BadRequestError' text
UI: Sonner toast visible with 'Emergent kredit vyčerpán — přepni na vlastní AI klíč v Nastavení' and 'Otevřít nastavení' action button
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _error_code currently checks only 'budget has been exceeded' and 'emergent_budget_exceeded' substrings — the paired _call_llm also matches 'max budget', so the phrase 'Max budget: 1.0 reached' alone (without being wrapped by _call_llm) would fall through to UPSTREAM_ERROR. Not a real bug today (all emergent budget errors get wrapped) but adding 'max budget' to _error_code would make the helper self-consistent with _call_llm.
Worker uses in-memory JOBS dict — restart of backend loses jobs; not a regression but worth noting for the roadmap.

Batch fallback (_translate_batch) only falls back to Emergent for non-emergent providers on 502/quota — for provider='emergent' with budget exhausted there is intentionally no fallback (correct behavior).
test_credentials: N/A (uses server-side EMERGENT_LLM_KEY which is intentionally budget-exhausted in this container)
seed_data_creation: Reused existing /tmp/small.gb (4KB) and /tmp/big.gba (2MB Pokemon Gen3) from iteration 2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Emergent Universal Key in this container is over budget by design so any provider=emergent translate reliably reproduces EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Backend pytest suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Playwright flow: upload /tmp/small.gb -> extract -> translate (default provider=emergent) -> assert terminal + toast + action button + dialog open.
rca of the issue: Original UX bug: end-user saw a giant repeated litellm.BadRequestError block including 'Emergent error: Failed to generate chat completion...Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 1.522912'. Two root causes: (1) _call_llm surfaced raw exception text; (2) worker did not abort and every batch produced its own copy of the noise. Fix (verified): _call_llm re-raises HTTPException(402, 'EMERGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ...'); worker sets abort_flag on first fatal batch and short-circuits remaining ones; status endpoint exposes structured error_code; frontend switches on error_code to show localized toast with 'Otevřít nastavení' action opening ai-settings-dialog. Terminal now shows exactly one friendly '! ERROR:' line.
